programs.title: The World's Deadliest Weather
programs.desc: Moving accounts of people who survived confrontations with the forces of nature.This series includes, among others:memories of earthquakes in Turkey and Syria and fires raging in Los Angeles.

programs.title: Treasures Decoded 2
programs.desc: A group of specialists from various fields will carefully examine: the pyramid of Cheops, statues from Easter Island, busts of Nefertiti, Blackbeard's ship, the Ark of the Covenant and the Spear of Destiny.

programs.title: Life Below Zero
programs.desc: Alaska has extremely harsh climatic conditions.Temperatures there regularly drop to life-threatening levels.Despite this, the region is inhabited by people.The tenth season of the program presents the everyday adventures of the inhabitants of four households from different parts of the Alaskan wilderness.Their lives focus primarily on hunting and careful preparations for and struggles with the long and frosty winter.Viewers will see, among others:Agnes Hailstone, who with her daughters tries to hunt caribou while her husband is away.
